content.name: Aditya Kulkarni
content.title: Senior Design Engineer
content.summary: Mechanical design engineer with nine years in automotive components, thermal systems and industrial pumps around Pune. Leads design for a centrifugal pump range, and value engineering on a casing family saved ₹1.1 crore a year without affecting efficiency.

experience.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
bullets: Rotated through design, production and quality for sheet-metal and machined brackets supplied to two-wheeler makers.
Prepared 2D drawings and BOMs in AutoCAD and Creo for about 80 parts, following customer drawing standards.
Supported a poka-yoke project on a welding line that reduced customer complaints for that part from 9 a month to 2.

experience.title: Design Engineer
bullets: Designed radiator and charge-air cooler assemblies for tractors and gensets in Creo.
Ran thermal sizing and CFD checks in ANSYS Fluent, keeping prototype test deviations within 5% of simulation.
Worked with suppliers on brazing fixtures, helping bring the first-pass yield of a new core from 82% to 93%.
Released engineering changes through Windchill and kept the DFMEA up to date for six product families.

experience.title: Senior Design Engineer
bullets: Lead mechanical design for a range of end-suction centrifugal pumps for water supply and industrial customers.
Value-engineered a casing family with the foundry, saving ₹1.1 crore a year with no loss in hydraulic efficiency.
Guide two design engineers and a draughtsman, reviewing models and drawings before release.
Prepare technical documents for tenders and customer audits, including performance test reports to IS and ISO standards.

education.school: College of Engineering Pune (COEP), Savitribai Phule Pune University

achievements.title: Cost-saving award
achievements.detail: Received the company's annual value engineering award in 2024 for the casing project.

achievements.title: BAJA SAEINDIA
achievements.detail: Design lead for the college ATV team, finishing in the top 20 nationally in 2016.
